pin.title: The Korean 7 Skin Method
pin.sub: Thin toner layers, pressed in by hand

steps.title: Pour into palms
steps.body: A coin-sized amount, no cotton pad.

steps.title: Press, pat, repeat
steps.body: Three thin layers, tacky in between.

pin.note: Find hydrating toners at Olive Young Global.

pins.title: Toner Layering at Home: Simple Korean Steps
pins.sub: Pick a gentle hydrating toner for this

items.title: Start on clean skin
items.body: Right after cleansing, while skin is slightly damp.

items.title: Coin-sized pour
items.body: Into your palms, then warm it for a second.

items.title: Press for 5 seconds
items.body: Cheeks, forehead, chin. Light taps, no rubbing.

items.title: Wait until tacky
items.body: Then add the next thin layer. Three is plenty.
